top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, decades-old discovery chain: Holst on the incretin effect and GLP-1 secretion, Drucker on proglucagon processing and peptide actions, Mojsov on the truncated bioactive peptide that made GLP-1 druggable. Randomized outcome trials in diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular and renal disease have validated the mechanism. The trio and a citation limited to physiology and active form keep the prize anchored to discovery. Contested priority (Habener and others) and Knudsen's exclusion are real limits but do not justify no award.
